summary.name: Rytr
summary.one_liner: Rytr is an AI relationship manager and follow-up assistant that pulls client context from email, Slack, calendars, and meeting notes into one brief, prepares meetings, and drafts follow-ups in your voice, with a separate AI writing tool called Create.
use_cases: follow up with clients on time
track promises and commitments made in email or Slack
draft follow-up emails in your own voice
get a daily priority brief of who needs you
write emails, posts, and ads with AI
summary.what_it_does: Rytr connects to the email, Slack, calendar, and meeting-note sources you choose and merges them into one picture per person, including open questions, promises, and changes like moved dates. It produces pre-meeting briefs, morning and evening briefs in the app or by iMessage/SMS, and drafts follow-ups that you review before anything is sent. A browser extension surfaces relationship context in Gmail, Slack, and LinkedIn and can bring its writing tool to any text box. Its Create side offers writing templates, 22 tones, 38 languages, and up to three variants per generation.
notable: Builds relationship memory from existing email, Slack, calendar, and call notes without manual data entry
Nothing is sent or changed without your approval; you can review and correct every stored memory
Reply by text to act on the brief, e.g. 'Send the Dana intro'
Create writing tool offers 40 use cases, 22 tones, and 38 languages
caveats: Email delivery of briefs is 'coming soon' per the page
Pricing details beyond 'start free' are not given on the page
Create's 'Help where the work happens' extension is described; the page does not state which browsers it supports
